## Details
### **SW-REQ-SIM-SCEN-001** — Human-Editable Scenario File Format

- **Description:** The sim scenario shall be defined in a human-editable text file format.
- **Rationale:** PM-required scenario authoring without recompilation; supports reviewable, diffable scenario configuration.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-045
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1, sim

### **SW-REQ-SIM-SCEN-002** — Launch Site Configuration

- **Description:** The sim scenario shall specify launch site geodetic latitude, longitude, and elevation.
- **Rationale:** PM-required launch site parameterization so simulated GPS and nav anchor to a configurable location.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-045
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1, sim

### **SW-REQ-SIM-SCEN-003** — Motor Thrust Curve Configuration

- **Description:** The sim scenario shall specify a time-indexed motor thrust curve for the simulated vehicle.
- **Rationale:** PM-required motor parameterization so different motors can be simulated for FT1 baseline and variants.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-045
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1, sim

### **SW-REQ-SIM-SCEN-004** — Vehicle Mass and Drag Configuration

- **Description:** The sim scenario shall specify simulated vehicle mass and aerodynamic drag parameters.
- **Rationale:** PM-required vehicle dynamics parameterization to match FT1 airframe properties for realistic trajectories.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-045
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1, sim

### **SW-REQ-SIM-SCEN-005** — Atmospheric Conditions Configuration

- **Description:** The sim scenario shall specify atmospheric pressure, temperature, and wind parameters.
- **Rationale:** PM-required atmospheric parameterization so baro and aero models reflect day-of-flight conditions.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-045
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1, sim

### **SW-REQ-SIM-SCEN-006** — Sensor Noise Parameter Configuration

- **Description:** The sim scenario shall specify per-sensor noise and bias parameters for IMU, baro, and GPS.
- **Rationale:** PM-required sensor noise parameterization so simulated sensor outputs match realistic FT1 hardware behavior.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-045
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1, sim

### **SW-REQ-SIM-SCEN-007** — Truth State Output File

- **Description:** The sim scenario shall write truth vehicle state to a sidecar output file during each simulation run.
- **Rationale:** PM-required truth-state recording enables post-run comparison of FSW nav output to ground truth.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-045
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1, sim

### **SW-REQ-SIM-SCEN-008** — Truth State Recording Rate

- **Description:** The sim scenario shall record truth state at the simulation integration rate.
- **Rationale:** PM-required full-rate truth recording so post-run analysis is not aliased by truth subsampling.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-045
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1, sim

### **SW-REQ-SIM-SCEN-009** — Monotonic Simulation Time Stamping

- **Description:** The sim scenario shall stamp every truth state record with monotonic simulation time.
- **Rationale:** PM-required monotonic sim time stamping enables alignment of truth records with FSW log records.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-045
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1, sim

### **SW-REQ-SIM-SCEN-010** — True Phase Transition Timestamps

- **Description:** The sim scenario shall record the true simulation time of each flight phase transition.
- **Rationale:** PM-required true phase transition record supports SW-REQ-SYS-018 AFM ±1 s tolerance comparison.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-018
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1, sim

### **SW-REQ-SIM-SCEN-011** — FT1 Default Baseline Scenario

- **Description:** The sim scenario set shall include a default FT1 baseline scenario with G-class motor and nominal noise.
- **Rationale:** PM-required canonical FT1 scenario (~600 m apogee, nominal noise) for repeatable regression simulation runs.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-045
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1, sim

### **SW-REQ-SIM-SCEN-012** — Scenario Selection via Command Line

- **Description:** The sim scenario loader shall select among multiple scenarios via Trick command line argument.
- **Rationale:** PM-required ability to switch scenarios without rebuilding supports nominal and off-nominal regression runs.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-045
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1, sim
